facts.fact: Bell Media's CTV page lists NFL game coverage in a press release that names TSN, CTV, Crave, and RDS as the broadcast platforms.
facts.quote: NFL on TSN, CTV, Crave, and RDS – Week 10: Patriots and Lions Go Head-to-Head in Munich

facts.fact: The CTV page lists six CTV-branded specialty channels: CTV Comedy, CTV Sci-Fi, CTV Life, CTV Drama, CTV Wild, CTV Nature, and CTV Speed.
